description: An oil-painting style scene of a tall black steel derrick rising over a flat, dusty desert beside a flat-topped rocky hill, with smoke drifting from machinery. In the foreground, two men in khaki work clothes and a hat bend over a wellhead spilling black crude, surrounded by about a dozen men in white and grey robes and headcloths, some gesturing. Pumping gear, tanks and a small stack sit on the right.
